subject: Jet proportions: exact scoped metadata, prior returns verified; same Lisan pass
body:
Jet audit update in the SAME existing Lisan writer-pass conversation. Root has recorded a new Lisan-scoped metadata backlog because the only established revision queue found is Hon-only; it was not modified. No new team/assignment or immediate Grok ping/generation. Keep Claude's writing moving and preserve existing look/identity grades.

Strongest new provisional target: LAG-JET-BLACK-DROP-5597b435a085 (moon helmet), wider/boxier torso and upper arms vs supplied solo REF-02. Secondary LAG-JET-BLACK-DROP-2c7a64ee70bd (wormhole helmet): broad upper chest, with pose/crop uncertainty; review only, no confirmed downgrade.
Prior returns EXIST: cc0e4d27d27e -> 083c1c99b8b2, 48e6cc177dbd -> 7395c055b930, 1bc0725e4df3 -> 9adc3c0462ea. They reduce torso bulk but are not user-accepted repairs; forearm/hand scale requires scoped comparison. Aurora originals have swapped HELMET/ORB filename labels, so retain hash-based lineage and visible-head uncertainty.
Actual audit covered 19 individual images and 3 contact sheets. Six story-linked intro/mission candidates did not justify blanket physique downgrades. REF-02 is solo-body comparison authority; REF-01 is companion-scene context. A liked look is not full physique approval. The existing desert-meeting composition ccd25e07763a and JET-01/02 cards remain preliminary inspiration, not finished production or new actor standards.

Please acknowledge this scoped caution with the consolidated two-track brief b0cb2b62-c990-4193-a0ce-230ae0fd85c7; next output remains one developed Lisan/Jet standalone introduction-action story plus connected seeds, with song themes developing separately and timestamps unset.
